entries.title: The mechanism survived the lab
entries.target: Qualify the chain, tokens, protocol fork, and controllable issuer-failure lifecycle before touching public state.
entries.summary: Pinned baselines, licensing boundaries, token controls, runtime headroom, and a full local Stock Token/Panoptic lifecycle were recorded.
outcomes: Local controllable-token lifecycle reached the accepted residual-accounting bound
Five Robinhood faucet Stock Tokens and candidate V4 dependencies were qualified read-only
evidence: 83 local tests in the final public-genesis checkpoint

entries.title: A missing singleton became an explicit safety model
entries.target: Adapt Panoptic's release process to Robinhood testnet without pretending its absent CREATE3 singleton or Safe-bound salts existed.
entries.summary: A deterministic direct-CREATE plan bound every predicted address to the deployer and exact nonce sequence, with offline preparation and one-step execution.
outcomes: 16-address sender-and-nonce plan simulated on a fresh fork
Hash-bound authorization and stop-on-mismatch operator created
CREATE3/Safe limitation isolated to deployment operations, not contract behavior

entries.title: Sixteen shared deployments landed cleanly
entries.target: Deploy the shared Panoptic V4 graph one transaction at a time and reconcile every runtime and constructor relationship.
entries.summary: Seven metadata data slices and nine protocol contracts were deployed from the pinned core release. Every canonical receipt and runtime matched the frozen plan.
outcomes: Factory, SFPM, RiskEngine, Guardian, references, libraries, and metadata available for markets

entries.title: A faucet-scale PLTR/WETH genesis was rehearsed
entries.target: Turn the first market choice into a bounded, synthetic, receipt-aware execution plan without public mutation.
entries.summary: The PoolKey, synthetic mechanism-test price, liquidity range, maximum token exposure, deadlines, cleanup, and receipt-derived NFT policy were replayed end to end.
outcomes: Synthetic 0.001 test WETH/PLTR policy labelled as non-market data
Twelve transitions and four expected failures passed on a fork
LP identity changed from prediction to canonical receipt derivation

entries.title: The first Panoptic market is registered
entries.target: Initialize PLTR/WETH, mint bounded V4 liquidity, clear temporary permissions, and register the per-market Panoptic graph.
entries.summary: Thirteen actor transactions completed across a safely stopped original run and a freshly simulated continuation. The final factory call created the PanopticPool and both CollateralTrackers.
outcomes: Uniswap V4 LP NFT 3903 minted with bounded two-sided liquidity
PanopticPool plus PLTR and WETH CollateralTrackers deployed and wired
All four ERC-20 and Permit2 allowances verified as zero

entries.title: The two-actor lifecycle now passes on a fork
entries.target: Open, observe, close, and clean up one bounded test position with distinct roles and fresh authorization.
entries.summary: A deterministic 25-call proposal now passes collateral, matched short/long positions, premium observation, ordered close, and allowance cleanup on an exact discarded fork. Adverse external-state cases, withdrawals, role review, and public authorization remain.
outcomes: 25/25 positive lifecycle calls passed with both actors ending at zero open legs
Robinhood's six-field V4 route encoding is isolated in a runtime-bound adapter
No transaction is currently authorized; public options, collateral, swaps, and the user application are not live
